Container.Name: 4-box-return
Container.Overview: Browser 2x2 multiviewer for checking YouTube, Facebook, X and Kaltura live streams are on air. Viewer at /, admin page at /admin.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the viewer and admin page are served on

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Where the stream list and box layout are saved

Config.Name: App port
Config.Description: Port the app listens on inside the container. Only change this when the container has its own IP (br0), since the Web UI port mapping is ignored there.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for the admin page (user name: admin). Leave empty for no password.
